early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
rules_primary: If Loudoun Water data center potable water use for Q1 2027, as published by the Virginia Department of Environmental Quality or Loudoun Water, is above 450 million gallons, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary: Only potable water Loudoun Water provides to data centers with a Virginia DEQ air permit counts, as reported under Va. Code § 62.1-44.38; reclaimed water does not count. If volumes are reported monthly, the January, February and March 2027 volumes are summed.
